recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the bounded Patient and Practitioner adoption requested by FHIR-12821 without expanding the fix to later resources or generated diagram artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-12821 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to split language usage by creating a common language value set that excludes dialects and by having Patient and Practitioner adopt it for spoken/understood communication language.
initial_application: Git commit 747f0b7cd9e26f4d74436f87f55e5a73d1009fe9, corresponding to svn revision 14493 noted in Jira, added source/terminologies/valueset-written-languages.xml and registered it in source/fhir.ini, but it did not update Patient.communication.language or Practitioner.communication.language.
additional_context: Current source keeps Patient and Practitioner in the active resource list and written-languages in the active value set list. The written-languages value set is described as excluding dialects and contains no regional hyphenated language tags, while the original Common Languages starter still contains regional variants. FHIR-18803 later corrected only a typo in that value set description and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed the starter additional binding for Patient.communication.language and Practitioner.communication.language from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/languages to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/written-languages, while preserving the required all-languages binding.
source_changes: source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml: changed Patient.communication.language starter additional binding from ValueSet/languages to ValueSet/written-languages.
source/practitioner/structuredefinition-Practitioner.xml: changed Practitioner.communication.language starter additional binding from ValueSet/languages to ValueSet/written-languages.
